Removing 50-foot TANPAT red zones along Alemany Boulevard with the installation of the new traffic
signal to allow additional parking. Near-side visibility red zones will be maintained along Alemany
Boulevard.

signalized intersections.
Decision: Approved by the City Traffic Engineer to forward to the SFMTA Board for final approval and
implementation.
